decisions.statement: The messages are answered oldest first.
The store is over-asked and the answer is narrowed against the decoded text.
The match the store makes minds the case and the match made after that match does not.
The newest matches win where more match than the limit allows.
A run of characters read from a file has no closing line ending.
A contact matching nobody refuses rather than answering empty.
A call saying no limit gives back twenty matches.
A call naming nothing to search for is refused before any file is read.

definition: the command giving back the messages whose text has a run of characters
